avis.texte: Hardly anything makes me break out, and this gave me red pimples all over my face. I used to use the blue retinol, so i figured purple would be fine. My face cleared up as soon as i stopped using this.

They changed the formula. The ingredients on the website are not the same as the box I got. And now this retinol that used to be my gentle retinol destroyer my skin. I woke up to redness all over. Companies should have to warn people of new formulas.
Great brand, product, and price! Don't overspend for prestige brands. This will give your comparable results!
this product is amazing, I apply after I apply vitamin C and it works fantastic.

I've tried a few different retinol products and this one has the same quality and results as more expensive brands. It's moisturizing, never irritates my skin, and helps with smoothness and clogged pores.

avis.titre: I do not feel this did anything for me
avis.texte: I just finished the bottle. I did not like the smell, it was a little like plastic. It really didn't seem to help my skin at all, and I actually got a little itchy sometimes after using it.

avis.titre: Caused a perioral dermatitis flare up!
avis.texte: I've been using CeraVe products for many years with no issues, so I thought I'd give this a try. I bought it at another retailer. I was using it over a three week period, a couple times a week, and last week my face started to have a perioral dermatitis flare! I haven't had a flare this bad in YEARS! I was concerned the retinol might be too harsh, but it was listed far down on the list so I was hoping it would be ok. Nope, not ok, and now my once clear skin is covered in blistery, weeping bumps. If you have ultra sensitive skin, be careful.

I'm a 28 years old woman who hates applying too much products on my face. Upon my dear friend's suggestion, i tried this retinol serum and it changed my life. Just loved how light weight and non greasy this serum is. I'm definitely buying it more and would love to recommend it to others.
I've made it 30 years with fairly clear skin aside from the random zit here and there. I bought this wanting to love it. I used it 3 times in the last week and my face is now completely broken out.
I use all of CeraVe skin renewing. I absolutely love it all. My skin feels so much better, face and body! I get compliments all of the time :)

I have tried other retinol products in the past and would get a rash on my face. I've had zero irritation with this product. My skin feels so smooth and my dermatologist even complemented the texture and appearance of my skin at my last visit! That felt great almost being 50!

avis.titre: The bottle will not dispense the product
avis.texte: I have used this product in the past and like it. However, this bottle will not dispense any product no matter how many times I have tried to pump it. I am going to return it for another one.

I had cystic acne during my teens and most of my 20's. I spent thousands of dollars in Dermatologist and other treatments. My acne was mostly in my nose that left me with deep scars. The last dermatologist I visited recommended CeraVe Products and I have used them for the past 3 or 4 years, mainly the face wash and face lotion. After 2 pregnancies my skin has taken a toll so I have more attention into my face. I use this product combined with CeraVe PM face lotion and I am very happy with the results! I combine with other CeraVe products rotating during the week such as CeraVe Skin Resurfacing Retinol Serum (blue one).
I love CeraVe and this one doesn't disappoint. Goes on smooth and doesn't irritate.
Super creamy and not sticky. I mix with the resurfacing serum.

This was my first attempt at a product with retinol in it, and it doesn't disappoint. I'm in the process of clearing up my face and this is so soft on my skin. It can burn from time to time (depends on which mask I use before), but Im able to use this twice a day like the bottle suggests without drying out.
I bought it in september before I needed it. I went to use it 2 weeks ago and it won't pump. It does work for my skin.

avis.titre: No smell, no caffeine, nice and light
avis.texte: One of my frustrations with retinol can be unpleasant smell and added caffeine (not good for a cream you use before bed). This one is light weight, no smell, and I fall asleep fine. I don't think the "wrinkle reducing power" is as strong as other creams I have used, but it is reasonably priced for my other needs.
I'm a newbie to using retinol creams, but I figured I'd give this a try. I've seen results in the first 2 weeks. I've been using this and CeraVe eye repair cream. I'm impressed.

avis.titre: Love Cerave but this pump didn't work
avis.texte: I love their products and use them nightly. I was so happy when they came out with a retinol. I have super sensitive skin and it's the only brand that works for me. I opened it and tried to apply the first night that I got it and I must have pumped 100 times and nothing came out. It was either empty or the pump had issues. I've repurchased and hoping the next one works better!

I have only been using this product for a week but so far my highly reactive, sensitive skin hasn't complained. It usually takes two weeks for my skin to react but I use many of the Cerave skin products and they are the only products that my skin can handle. Hoping to see some results from this retinol serum. I will buy it again if I see results and don't react to it.

avis.titre: okay but no wow factor for me
avis.texte: didn't diminish my fine lines around eyes, forehead or laugh lines. leaves skin feeling soft and moisturized but didn't really address the lines themselves. I saw better results when switching to LA roche posay retinol from ulta, it came as a sample but I liked it so much I bought one.

avis.titre: The one and only retinol serum I use,love it!
avis.texte: It's very absorbent but not drying in any way. It leaves my skin soft and smooth with no irritation on my sensitive skin.
Takes a couple of weeks but definitely tell the deference. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: I been buying this product for couple months now.
avis.texte: I love this product is one of my go to on my daily routine. Highly recommended
I couldn't believe how quickly I saw a change in my skin. You would never know this was such an affordable product.
Have used for a while. Good to keep skin soft and smooth without being oily. Use nightly.

This is my first time using retinol and I have more dry sensitive skin. I've been worried to try retinol for fear of irritation but this has been great. Started using every other day and now every day and I've noticed a huge difference! My husband says my crows feet are less noticeable!
Love this stuff. You only need a small drop and I used only for two days and seen a difference. Very mild on skin no redness or dryness.
I have very sensitive skin and struggled with acne's after getting off bc. This is such a good buy, you can feel and see a difference within a night. My skin has not been clearer and less irritated.

I should've listened to myself and invested in a better retinol. I know the formula isint good when my skin started breaking out! If you have sensitive skin , domt waste your money, invest in the good stuff

I have only been using it for about a week but I do feel that I see a difference and I like the product! Has no scent and is easy to use/ apply. I will continue using this and probably buy it again. Affordable price and great product :)
I love this so much it makes my skin glow and make me look younger
I usually use Cerave Resurfacing Retinol Serum but decided to try this one. I'm not prone to break outs but had terrible red, blistery breakouts. I love Cerave products but not this one.

I just finished my first bottle and it has been a roller coaster. It left my skin looking bright and healthy before inevitably causing it to purge. If I allowed myself to go through it, my skin would most likely look incredible by now. I wish I had that kind of patience. I plan on buying this product again, but hopefully with more restraint.

I meant to buy the resurfacing product but bought this one by mistake and I'm pleased despite it not being the product I wanted to buy. I think my skin has a brighter tone and a smoother texture to it.

I don't have anything good or bad to write about this product. It didn't cause breakouts, redness, or irritation… it didn't really do anything. I've been using it for a month now and there are been no noticeable changes in my fine lines or overall skin health. It's a fairly cheap retinol cream, so it's worth a try if you're interested. I do recommend mixing it in with your moisturizer in case you do have skin sensitivities because retinol can cause irritations.

I have sensitive combo skin and this product caused really bad breakouts. Painful cystic acne that I' haven't experienced since I was a preteen. I used it for about 3 1/2 weeks and I'm stopping use today. My skin complexion was more even and bright before I used this product. No acne breakouts whatsoever before I used this product, just uneven skin complexion and a little dull. I was just looking to try something new for a little extra, radiance and skin texture benefits. I believe it's related to the niacinamide in this product. I've used niacinamide before and the same thing happened. I believe I have a sensitivity to it. Again, I was interested in this products claim to improve skin texture and radiance. Which it did nothing of the sort. My skin looks horrible now and I'm going to have to add a few acne related products into my routine until my skin calms down. Which is going to likely dry my skin out. This product threw a monkey wrench in my routine. 🥴 If you are looking for the same thing as me I would suggest Ceraves Vitamin C serum and a snail cream. I used the vitamin c serum for over six months now and I do see a benefit. Snail cream has also helped even my skin before without breaking it out. Taking this out of my routine right away.
I tried it for a month and it doesn't work. I use other retinols regularly and this wasn't it
I got zero results after using this product. It also feels like it doesn't absorb well even with correct amount of product used

This product is wonderful!!!! I apply it at night after washing my face and in the morning with makeup . Let me tell you i don't use any primer and use this instead and my makeup looks so beautiful. My pours do not show anymore when applying foundation. I have sensitive skin and also dry spot and it just makes my skin feel so nice !

avis.titre: Absolutely life changing for my hormonal acne
avis.texte: I've struggled with hormonal acne literally my entire life. I've tried every medication, serum, acid, peroxide, and treatment under the sun and never seen results like this. I bought this for preventive wrinkle care, eased into it starting twice a week mixed with moisturizer. It made my acne worse at first, and right when I was about to ditch it 3 weeks later, I noticed how clear my skin was getting. A good skin day for me used to be 3-5 zits around my mouth area at a time. I now only get 1 small zit a week, if any. Highly recommend!

Listen, I've tried tons of high end products and still my skin always felt like it was missing something. I decided to give this a try when I saw it at my ulta store and let me tell you this stuff is amazing!! I'm only 23 so I didn't know if I needed the wrinkle benefits it offers. However, just after one week my skin was softer, brighter and tighter. I tend to struggle with sun spots and now my skin tone has evened out. Will be purchasing another bottle!

avis.titre: Not sure about results, don't like the way it feels
avis.texte: I'm on the fence about this product. I can't speak much to results, because I'm only 21 so I'm using this as a preventative measure for aging. I will say I have acne scars that don't seem to really be going anywhere after 2 months of using this. Also, I do NOT like the way it goes on. It feels really sticky and it's hard to distribute around my face because of that. I'm going to finish the bottle, but I might look for something else after that.

Love this retinol serum!!!! It's gentle yet so effective! I saw the difference in my skin after 1 use. My frown lines appeared to be little smoother and the overall tone of my face seemed brighter. I've tried different brands of retinol serums and I think this serum is, by far, my favorite. It's so reasonably priced and so effective~~ a win win combination! Highly recommend!!!

avis.titre: Yes, I will definitely but this product again & again.
avis.texte: I started using this product 1 week ago & I can already see a real difference - the redness in my face is almost gone!
cleanse, apply hyaluronic serum, then apply this Cera Ve retinol serum, then moisturize

Let me start by saying I'm blessed with great skin. My skin type is normal and I don't get acne. I wanted to start using a retinol for the anti aging properties. After the first night I noticed my skin was so soft and any texture I had was gone. After about 3 weeks of using every other night I can say this is a holy grail product and I will be repurchasing.

avis.titre: noticed changes after the first days of use
avis.texte: I was skeptical at first, because I usually spend more on skin care but am pleasantly surprised that after a few days my skin appeared brighter, and felt softer to touch without much irritation. I'm anxious to see the changes in the next month. I did use a moisturizer on top of the serum to help with dryness and of course don't forget the sunscreen

I used to be a skin care snob. Only tje expensive stuff for me. I noticed that my skin was feeling dry even and did some research. I got a sample of the night renewing and cleanser. Now I ise the whole line of Cereve. Why did I waste all that money? This stuff works just as well maybe even better! Never going back.

avis.titre: A little dab will do... wonders for your skin
avis.texte: I'm a gal who loved the sun in my younger years and I have subtle lines around my eyes to prove it. This product, in one week, has softened those lines with a subtle plumbing effect and has brightened my skin. My 11 year old daughter actually told me my skin was glowing... and outs pretty much say what's on their minds. Lol. Biggest tip? Use a small dab in each area and fully massage it in. I then layer my day/night moisturizer over it. It leaves my skin feeling quenched, not greasy. Love it.

I purchased this to help with small lines and moisturizing my face. Unfortunately it did just the opposite. I will admit that you tightened every spot on my face but that's only because it dried it out so much that I literally looked like I had a sunburn and my face was cracking. It turned my face red and began to peel. I don't know if I had a reaction or if it's just not the right product for me. Either way, this definitely did not work well for me. Sorry…
I use every night after cleansing my face. Soaks right in never feels greasy.
Use it before my moisturizer, it's my first retinol and I love it! I didn't experience any negative side effects or stinging like I've heard can happen with retinol.
This product is priced well and though I haven't been using it for long, it seems to be working well so far! It's gentle on my skin and easy to apply. I will likely purchase it again.
I had purchased this to add a retinol to my routine again that I could just throw on before my moisturizer and rose hip oil. Works great with all my other products and I plan on repurchasing this

CeraVe is a great line of products. As a mature lady I am careful what I put on my skin. Not a fan of all kinds of chemicals to look good in my skin care and makeup. This does not sting or cause redness. It does a nice job on my skin. You don't need a lot, pump it out, smooth it on and that's it. The bottle is small for the price, but for me it is a clean product recommended by my dermatologist.
Clean, non-fragrant cream serum, the serum absorbs quickly. Does stay a little tacky on skin, let it dry about 5 or 6 minutes before applying any moisturizer.

I hate giving a bad review, and I hardly ever leave reviews unless I feel strongly about something. Suffice it to say, I feel strongly about this one and feel I have to write something since they changed the formula up and I don't want people to have issues and wonder what the heck the old reviews in 2019 and years before were talking about. The original formulation in the tube was amazing. I'm in my early thirties, have combination sensitive skin (t-zone oily, everything else drier than the Sahara and it gets irritated easily), and I have a simple skincare routine that I had perfected and have specific products that I've used for a few years to minimize milia and breakouts in the t-zone and keep everything else on my face happy and moisturized enough. This stuff was my holy grail when it came to a serum. Then they changed this to the pump bottle and dropped the "cream" part from the name so it's just the "skin renewing retinol serum", which started happening right around December 2019. Okay, that was a little worrying. But I might as well try it out since I didn't really have a choice, as the original was suddenly impossible to find anywhere. I hoped for the best and that it wouldn't mess up my routine and it'd still be my HG and keep my skin happy. Point blank - It's not the same and it made my skin angrier than it's been in a long while. This is the only product I've used in the last few years that changed. After I started using the new one, I immediately started having is

avis.titre: Pretty good but hard to sqeeze
avis.texte: I use this at night after washing my face. I apply, let dry and then use a heavy cream. I also apply to neck. Very good results except on forward which is slightly oily. My neck is much smoother and my skin is looking better every day. The results aren't instant. It took about a month to see results
So far so good. I ordered this & another kind to test the difference. I will update when I'm done testing .

Love this serum, I use it with the CeraVe vitamin c serum and their skin renewing night cream. My skin is so much brighter and even toned than it used to be. Have not seen a significant difference in the creases in my forehead, but I have around my eyes. I'm sure this will continue to get better as I continue to use. I have been using these products for about 3 months and I will continue to use this line of products!
This is a great retinol, It doesn't irritate my skin and I can see a difference in the texture and clarity of my skin.

I purchased this serum a few weeks ago while desperately searching for an affordable hydrating serum - I have pretty dry skin and no matter how great my skin care routine was I would have visible dry patches on my nose and forehead in the mornings while applying makeup (not a cute look). This serum has made a noticeable difference in my makeup application but more importantly just with the overall look and feel of my skin. I'm a fan, and I'll definitely repurchase after this puppy runs out

avis.titre: Didn't help with forehead creases/frown lines
avis.texte: I purchased the CeraVe Skin Renewing Retinol Cream Serum because it was recommended for fine lines and wrinkles. Specifically I was looking for a product that would help minimize forehead creases and frown lines. I used the CeraVe Skin Renewing Retinol Cream Serum for over a month, applying to my forehead twice daily per product instructions. During the day I wore the product under makeup, and at night just with moisturizer (both allowing the product to fully absorb before applying anything else). The product is easy to apply, absorbs quickly, is not greasy, and has no unappealing odor. So far I have seen zero change in the appearance of my forehead creases and frown lines. Perhaps my creases are too far gone for this product to help, but for me, it is not worth purchasing again.

avis.titre: Really wanted to like this, but it pills...
avis.texte: First let me say that I really love all the CeraVe products I've tried in the past. I liked this one at first too--it feels hydrating and smooth on the skin, though thicker than I would expect from a serum--but it pills up after an hour or two. I do layer it with other skincare (CeraVe moisturizer/SPF in the morning and cream and oil at night), and I don't feel like it's enough to just use by itself. I've tried applying the other products immediately, I've tried letting it dry first--still pills up. If I sweep my hand across my face I get a handful of crumbles. It's really frustrating because I did want to like this, but it's all but unusable for me due to the texture. Oh well. (For the record, I used this to minimize texture and sebaceous filaments around my T-zone, not for wrinkles, so I can't speak to its anti-aging ability.)

avis.titre: broke me out and i am not acne prone
avis.texte: broke me out it feels nice and hydrating but beware of breakouts
Wow after just one week I see such a difference in the fine lines in my forehead and near my brows! I've tried so many products and this is by far one of the best!

I do not like this product. First off, I have been using it for a month now. I do not see or feel any sort of difference in my face whatsoever. It is greasy and smells like my grandma's perfume. The more I use it, the harder it is to dispense the cream. I can't even get one little dot to come out. So tonight, as I'm squeezing the tube that obviously has a lot of cream left in it, trying to get a little dot to come out to apply, the cream explodes out of the backside of the tube all over me and my bathroom. I'm so frustrated that I even spent money on this. Into the trash it goes! I feel like I'm crazy because I bought this due to the excellent reviews, but that's my experience. 10/10 would not buy ever ever again.

I purchased this item because it says "...Retinol Cream". When I got home, and was reviewing the Ingredients List, to my disgust, there was No retinol in the ingredients list. Can the manufacturer point to us where in the Ingredients List does it say there is Retinol?

I bought this product to try out because it was a more affordable serum for fine lines. I really liked it and am going to order it again after I finish this review! I have extremely oily skin and this stuff absorbed in my skin with no problem at all. I definitely recommend this stuff!
I use this in the morning and at night. I love how it leaves my face feeling moist but not "greasy ".
I've only been using this produce for a few days so I don't know how it will deliver long-term. However, so far my skin does look better in the morning. I think I will be purchasing it again.

avis.titre: Best low line serum I've tried
avis.texte: Am an Ulta obsessed product person, always have been obsessed with creams and serums. And happy to say always told I look much younger than my 60 years. I can only find this serum in the Cerave line at Ulta. I have never been able to find it at other stores that carry Cerave product. It is top notch, and so comparable to prestige line serums. TOTALLY worth trying if you find it, use under and with any moisture cream if you need it. Great for beginnings of lines, wrinkles.
Been using this for two weeks ago haven't seen a different. Makes my face feel greasy and I broke out. I might give it away. Never get it again.

I am in my mid-twenties, so I wanted to start a casual anti-aging regimen. Didn't want to be hardcore about it. This is perfect for brightness and subtle differences in the skin. I have extremely sensitive skin, and this has not given me any breakouts. I 100% recommend. Also, I never write reviews.. so theres that!
the pump is interesting. sometimes it pumps out nicely and sometimes it's one big goop. it does moisturize nicely but it's the pump that frustrated me hence the Stars.
This was my first trek into using a retinol in my nightly routine and I freaking love it, plus I can already see that it's doing wonderful things for my face!

avis.titre: Yes I will be re buying!
avis.texte: I have super sensitive skin!! Its oily, acne prone, & will break out with almost anything BUT Cera Ve products don't break me out at all! This serum hasn't dried me out or anytbing! No breakouts and is helping to make my pores appear smaller! I LOVE CERAVE!
I've only been using this a couple of weeks, but so far I like it. It's super light weight and non-greasy!

Unfortunately, I never found out if it actually works because I only used it 5 times. It caused little white bumps on my face the day I started using it. They went away when I stopped using the product. I wonder why this happened. I don't have sensitive skin.

I can definitely tell a difference in my light wrinkles when using this product - used daily on the back of my hands, around my eyes and neck area. When I stop using it for a day or two, the wrinkles/lines show up again. It makes enough of a difference that I am willing to continue buying and using the product. Also, there is no irritation with my sensitive skin which I have found with other products.
My skin is so much softer the hyaluronic acic in it is diminishing wrinkles and fine lines and actually taking redness away! Improving my skin and dryness and acne sensitive combination skin!

Just started using it a day ago and it did say you would see results very soon - I agree. Hopefully not my imagination, but my lines seem much more 'plumped' - and all Cera Ve products are paraben free so that's an extra plus. Highly recommend.
I've only used it a few times and it's nice and light. I'm new to this acid stuff so I'm taking it slow. So far so good.
I have always used an Olay regenerist serum but this stuff is great too for use together or just to change it up.

CeraVe Skin Renewing Retinol Cream Serum is a must-have for anyone. I apply to my face and neck every night before I apply moisturizer. I see a difference after 4 weeks of use! My fine wrinkles are minimized, especially those pesky forehead lines, and my skin is glowing! I am glad I found this product at the local drugstore. No more paying high prices for anti-aging skincare. Hyaluronic Acid and Retinol rock!

I have used the product for several months and will continue to repurchase. It is highly-reviewed by many health professionals and I find it to be a great product in my skincare routine. I use Retin-A, but use this product in more sensitive areas, skin below the eye, creases of the nose and on my neck. Gentle, yet effective.

I have sensitive skin and allergies, but really wanted to use a serum with retinol. This line was recommended by my dermatologist so I took a chance. It is completely non-irritating, and I use it morning and evening under my moisturizer. It seems to soften my skin, I definitely think lines are less noticeable, and even though it's not advertised as such, my skin seems to be more even-toned. It's definitely not a prescription retinoid, but that's perfect for me.
I have extremely dry skin and eczema and it noticeably helps without stinging!!!

This made my dry skin feel more moisturized. I use it nightly on face, neck and hands to moisturize. My fine lines and wrinkles are less noticeable when skin is well moisturized. I would prefer no retinol so that I could use it without worrying about sun protection.

I really like the way this feels on my skin. It absorbs quickly and doesn't seem to interfere with putting makeup over top of it. I use it before Cerave PM moisturizer both day and night. I've been using it for about 2 weeks and I haven't noticed much of an improvement in my fine lines/wrinkles but I have noticed that my skin feels much more hydrated and smooth and it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I agree with the other reviews about the product being extremely difficult to get out of the tube. For this reason, I don't know if I will purchase it again.

avis.titre: I have been using this product for almost 2 years
avis.texte: I use this product every night before I go to bed. It feels wonderful and it's almost feels like it's reversing my aging. I know I don't look my age I'm 56 and nobody guesses me out of my forties LOL

I have sensitive skin and allergies. I've been able to use this with no problem. My skin looks smooth and pretty with this on (under my sunscreen and moisturizer) and feels very smooth and soft. Haven't been using it long enough to rate longer term results but it's affordable, dermatologist recommended and so far, so good.

I use it every morning and every evening. I love it, I noticed a difference in my skin within a few weeks. Just bought my 3rd bottle. It's a must for me. After 40 i developed a duller skin tone and some dark spots on my upper cheeks. Using this, my skin is fresh and pink looking, younger looking, and my spots are very, very faded. I like it better than Roc.
The serum made my skin sticky. Not a fan of that feeling. It does moisturize well though. I'd repurchase if the tube contained more product. 1oz for $17? No.

The best product, ever. After using for just 30 days, my dermatologist said she'd never seen my skin look so good. I started using on my dermatologist's suggestion. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this product. And one of the best things it's not expensive.

avis.titre: I use this twice a day. Love it!
avis.texte: I use this morning and night as an eye cream and around my mouth especially. Also on my forehead and on the "elevens". Then I put on my Cerave Day Cream with sun block. At night I use Cerave skin renewing night cream.

avis.titre: AMAZING RESULTS! Best out there! So glad I bought it!
avis.texte: I have tried many MANY MANY creams and serums and this one was just amazing! In just one use noticed immediate results on wrinkles especially with forehead wrinkles. My whole face looked different after just one application! This blows everything else I have tried away. I bought this and also got the day time cream and night cream. All those are amazing and this was simply the best I have ever used! Will never be without now! It is a really amazing product and so glad I tried it. Also its not expensive and these are expensive results! I literally had someone tell me I look 15 years younger than I am... (BTW I RARELY write reviews for products but this one people must know how great it is!!) Truly amazing product...also I am very sensitive and this did not make me tear or get stuffy or sneeze or anything..no scent and completely absorbs and feels great! SO unbelievably happy with it!

I use this instead of my tretinoin medication on my chin and around my nose, so that I still get the benefits of a retinol product without all the flaking and peeling that tretinoin causes in those areas. I've noticed great improvements in those areas on my face since using this serum. Definitely evened out some hyperpigmentation issues and refined the texture.

avis.titre: This stuff is a miracle for me
avis.texte: I have mild eczema that sometimes pops up around my mouth. after it got so bad it looked like chemical burns, I got this stuff to try. First time I did I saw results in less than 3 days. I repurchased it when it started to come back, and I had the same results. I use it on my face once or twice a day depending on how my skin looks and it lasts a long time for how small the bottle is. I can't say much for under make up, but if I put it on while my face is wet it does have a soapy effect and can leave a tiny bit of residue if you don't run it in all the way. But this is something I'll be keeping in my skincare routine forever.
I like and use other Cerave products but this one just doesn't work for me. I seem to break out from something in this the more I used it so sadly I had to return. Just seemed to irritate my skin.
I've been using this daily and my skin absorbs it quickly without feeling heavy.

avis.titre: I like it but only for night time
avis.texte: This is great but only as a night serum. During the day it pills under makeup no matter how I've tried to apply it. I use this after toning and applying a prescription acne medicine, I sort of press it into my skin and neck instead of rubbing. Then I moisturize and use eye cream before bed. Overall I'm pleased with this product, it doesn't irritate my skin even with the retinol (I've used retin A before and it was brutal) and doesn't break me out. I've noticed my skin has lost some acne marks and scarring and the surface is a lot smoother which is awesome. Doesn't do anything for pore size but I'm not sure it's supposed to either. I will continue to buy this and use it at night before moisturizing.
I use this morning and night. Light and not greasy. Do not need a moisturizer but I have oily skin. Feels great. I used more expensive products for a while. I went back to this

avis.titre: Love this product, have been using it for two years
avis.texte: Plumps your skin And reduces fine lines. Soaks into your skin

I didn't expect much from a drug store brand but this product does everything it claims and does it quickly. I noticed results after just a few days with tighter skin, less fine lines, smaller pores and more even tone. I'm not easily impressed but I know I'll never stop using this serum.

avis.titre: My go-to anti-aging product for my sensitive neck
avis.texte: I use a prescription retinoid on my face, but the skin on my neck just can't seem to acclimate. So I use this serum on my neck, to maintain elasticity and keep the wrinkles away. I've tried some other products and I always come back to this. My dermatologist is a big fan of Cera Ve products, so I feel like this is a good choice. PSA...If you're using a retinoid, WEAR SUNSCREEN EVERY DAY!!!

avis.titre: Part of my "Holy Grail" skin care routine
avis.texte: This is my 3rd repurchase of this product. I apply 1 to 2 pumps to my face & neck until thoroughly absorbed (even around my eyes), right after cleansing. Then follow it with CeraVe Facial Moisturizing lotion & CeraVe Eye Repair cream. All 3 products apply & absorb so easily. No greasy feel. No fragrance. Great for my dry, "mature", and sometimes sensitive skin. I've noticed an improvement in the softness of my skin and decrease in fine lines. I use this at night & under my makeup every day. Compared to other "high end" products that contain retinal & ceramide, I think the price point is pretty reasonable. Love it!

I bought this product on a whim, looking for something that would help reduce the size of my giant pores. I found this because I remember using a light retinol formula when I was younger that worked well for my severely acne prone skin. As an adult, I wanted something similar that would minimize my pores, help tighten my pot-marked skin, and not break me out. This product does all of that!!! And I started noticing results immediately after the first use. This has worked so well for me and has done exactly what I had hoped it would do for my skin. Note: a little goes a long way.
